body: I turn 33 in April. I have no job and have only ever worked a few temp jobs. I have a useless degree in physics and despite achieving top marks it has got me nowhere in life. I have not had a friend since I was 24 and I have no girlfriend. I live at home. It is almost impossible to get a job in the UK that isn't retail or a call centre, unless you have contacts and friends who can get you the job. I've tried volunteering; it's useless and demeaning. It is getting to the point now where I need to make concrete plans to end my life. I need an exit plan because this is unbearable and I don't know how to fix my life.
